title: My Phone Showed Tomorrow's News… Then It Showed MY Name
description:
What if your phone showed tomorrow's news? 📱

You win the lottery. You stop a bus crash. You feel unstoppable…
until one morning, the top story is about YOU.

Who's been sending you tomorrow's news? 👀 Tell us your theory in the comments!
